messages:
zoe: Quick thread: building the launch checklist for eval-triggered alerts + quant advisor. Want minimal scope for pilot so we can sign a couple customers fast.

alan: which parts are mandatory for pilot vs nice-to-have?

zoe: Mandatory: alert plumbing (console + webhook), redacted sample diffs, quant advisor that shows top-2 configs with estimated latency/cost delta. Nice-to-have: in-console quick-apply, residency badges, fancy impact comb.

tess: Ops constraints: webhooks + console alerts are easy. Redaction is nontrivial only if we try to show long context. Keep samples tiny (<= 80 chars) and link to full context in customer storage.

omar: Profiling note: to keep cost bounded for pilot, limit profiling to 500 samples/model/run and default cadence weekly. Also expose estimated cost before run.

liz: UX: MVP diff view = list of failing prompts, two short outputs side-by-side, small bar showing cost delta and ms change. Add a simple accept/ignore action per-recommendation. No auto-apply in pilot.

zoe: Draft acceptance criteria (quick):
```
AC1: Alerts delivered to console + webhook within 30m 95% of the time.
AC2: All alert examples are PII-redacted by default; full context accessible only via customer-hosted link.
AC3: Quant advisor surfaces max 2 recommended configs with sample diffs and estimated latency/cost delta.
AC4: Profiling cap = 500 samples/model/run for pilot; cost estimate shown before run.
AC5: Pilot customers must opt-in per-model; no auto-apply in Phase 1.
```

alan: Add econ gate: require >=10% unit cost reduction OR >=60ms p95 latency drop for 2/2 pilot customers before enabling auto-apply in Phase 2.

zoe: Agree. Also safety net: if any config causes >=3% absolute quality drop on labeled harness, require manual rollback and disable auto-apply.

tess: Action items: 
- @omar: prototype 500-sample profiler + cost calc by Mon.
- @liz: mockup compact diff + accept/ignore UI by Tue.
- @alan: draft econ gate sim for AcmeHealth and Inboxly by Wed.
- @zoe: compile legal redaction wording and pilot opt-in text.

ci-bot: test pipeline green for eval-alerts branch :white_check_mark:

zoe: Thanks team. I'll fold these into the initiative doc and loop in legal/ops. If no objections by EOD Fri we push outreach.
